Quaternius building assets - provenance notice

The four OBJ/MTL pairs in this directory are:

- 1Story_GableRoof.obj / 1Story_GableRoof.mtl
- 2Story_GableRoof.obj / 2Story_GableRoof.mtl
- 2Story_Wide.obj / 2Story_Wide.mtl
- 2Story_RoundRoof.obj / 2Story_RoundRoof.mtl

Quaternius publishes its free building packs with OBJ files and a CC0
license. The candidate official pack pages checked on 2026-09-08 are:

- Buildings Pack: https://quaternius.com/packs/buildings.html
- Simple Buildings Pack: https://quaternius.com/packs/simplebuildings.html

Both pages declare CC0-1.0 and OBJ distribution. Their currently published
Google Drive archives use different filenames, so the exact local file-to-pack
match has not been proven. This notice intentionally records that limitation;
it must not be read as a claim that the source archive was identified.

The upstream site license page, last updated 2026-08-28, now describes the
Quaternius Asset License rather than CC0:
https://quaternius.com/license.html

Because these files were already present before this notice was added, the
download date and the license version that applied on that date are not known
from repository evidence. Resolve the exact source archive and applicable
license before claiming release-grade legal clearance.

2026-10-20 source resolution:

The exact pack was identified as Quaternius "Ultimate Buildings Pack"
(December 2019):

- https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatetexturedbuildings.html
- Official Drive folder:
  https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RE3qXhbE5yGS3t-xGFJ8GmOtTgCUF3LQ
- Models with Materials / OBJ folder:
  https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MfEng5EbtFU0-L9SHqcU6Mm3gKlUk37k

The official OBJ folder lists the corresponding upstream names:

- 1Story_GableRoof_Mat.obj / .mtl
- 2Story_GableRoof_Mat.obj / .mtl
- 2Story_Wide_Mat.obj / .mtl
- 2Story_RoundRoof_Mat.obj / .mtl

The local files are derived exports: the "_Mat" suffix is removed and the
material list is simplified to one material. Geometry evidence from the public
awplanet mirror at commit 40c01a6984e35b24bad0c1222c6c5970b64f18d2 matches
1Story_GableRoof (1227 vertices / 831 faces / 2852 texture coordinates) and
2Story_Wide (3577 / 2505, with 7678 local vs 7680 mirrored texture
coordinates). The mirror also names the source as "Ultimate Buildings Pack".

The official pack page still declares CC0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The current global Quaternius Asset License (QAL v1.0), checked 2026-10-20,
permits use in personal, educational, and commercial products without
attribution, but prohibits redistributing the raw assets as a standalone asset
pack. QAL section 7 says later versions do not apply retroactively. The exact
download date is still unknown from repository history, so this notice records
both the pack's publication-time CC0 declaration and the current QAL terms
instead of asserting a single historical grant date.

Earlier candidate-pack check retained for audit:

- Buildings Pack (Jan 2019): Building1_Large.obj, Building1_Small.obj,
  Building2_Large.obj, Building2_Small.obj, Building3_Big.obj,
  Building3_Small.obj, Building4.obj, House1.obj, House2.obj.
- Simple Buildings Pack (Aug 2017): Bank.obj, Flat.obj, Flat2.obj,
  Hospital.obj, House.obj, House2.obj, House3.obj, House4.obj, House5.obj,
  Shop.obj.

Neither candidate list contains these names. They belong to the Ultimate
Buildings Pack rather than those two earlier packs.
